title: finding(plugin-grid,core): the selection bar hides a bulk action authored `visible: '   '` that the same grid's rows and toolbars show; `bulkEligibility.hasVisibilityGate` and core `partitionRowsByPredicate` keep their own "is a gate declared?" test
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect, class (a), the objectui#3812 declared-gate class. `reach:` the real plugin-grid `BulkActionBar` (the grid's selection bar), rendered with one selected row and measured by the objectui#11294 dev. The probe went through the component, not through a registered `object-grid` node on a page. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from objectui#11294's dev report (`out_of_scope_findings[0]`), confirmed by PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11319's contract review (`5924036373` ③). ⛔ Not graded here.

Dedup: among the 600 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (read through REST and grepped locally), `BulkActionBar`, `bulkEligibility`, `partitionRowsByPredicate` and `hasVisibilityGate` match only PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11283 (closed). That PR diagnosed a blank gate on three other paths and left this one as it was. The declared-gate family's earlier cards (objectui#3812, objectui#3521, objectui#11244, objectui#11270) are all closed.

## Measured (objectui `main` `caa0cd3927`, after PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11283)

| authored `visible` on a bulk action | selection bar | row menu and toolbar (after PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11319) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `'   '` | **hidden** | shown |
| `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '   ' }` | **hidden** | shown |
| `''` (the control) | shown | shown |
| no gate (the control) | shown | shown |

## The cause (read at source)

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/bulkEligibility.ts` `hasVisibilityGate` (about `:75`) tests `visible != null && visible !== ''`.
- `packages/core/src/evaluator/listConditional.ts` `partitionRowsByPredicate` (about `:392`) opens the same way (`pred == null || pred === ''`).
- So a whitespace gate is evaluated, fails closed for every row, leaves `eligible` empty, and `BulkActionBar.tsx` (about `:48`) returns `null`.
- Before PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11319 the selection bar agreed with the rows and disagreed with the toolbars. After it, the selection bar is the one surface that disagrees.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- The same rule as objectui#11294's triage direction (`5922536242`): the selection bar asks the family's `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate` (core `hasDeclaredPredicate`). Blank or whitespace text and an empty envelope mean no gate: shown, with ADR-0137 D4's `[blank]` report.
- ⛔ No new "declared?" test. The one row helper PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11319 exported, or core's `hasDeclaredPredicate` directly, serves both `bulkEligibility` and `partitionRowsByPredicate`.
- **Pins:** the table above through the real selection bar, and one through a registered `object-grid` node (the probe this card did not run).
- Also noted from the same report (read at source, no reach, not this card): the built-in Edit / Delete `visibleWhen` keeps `!= null`, and the record header (`RecordDetailView` `useRowPredicate`, fallback `false`) hides on a blank. Both are ADR-0137 field-rule keys outside this family.

Dedupe words: `hasVisibilityGate` · `partitionRowsByPredicate blank` · `bulk action visible whitespace` · `selection bar declared gate` · `BulkActionBar blank visible`
